description:
Tracer 29” GT/GT7 Speed Bicycles Avalon Beach Cruiser Bikes - Elevate Your Ride!
Introducing the Tracer29” GT/GT7 Speed Bicycles Avalon Beach Cruiser Bikes, where classic design meets modern performance. Whether you're a seasoned cyclist or just starting your biking journey, these cruisers are designed to provide an unparalleled riding experience that suits both adult women and men.
Timeless Design:
The Tracer Avalon Beach Cruiser boasts an eye-catching design that seamlessly fuses nostalgia with contemporary style. Available in a range of captivating colors, including Matte Green/Green, Matte Black/Polished, and Matte Grey/Orange for the Single Speed option, as well as Matte Black/Polished and Matte Grey/Orange for the 7 Speed version, these cruisers are sure to turn heads as you cruise along the beach or explore the city streets.
Built for Comfort:
Equipped with a Tracer Steel Hi-Rise Handlebar measuring 13 inches wide and 29.5 inches tall, these cruisers provide an upright and comfortable riding position that reduces strain on your back and shoulders. The Vacuum Elastic PVC leather saddle features high-density PU foam and springs, ensuring a plush and supportive seat that cushions your every ride.
Smooth Shifting and Control:
The 7 Speed variant features a Shimano SL-RS35R 7-speed shifter, allowing you to effortlessly switch between gears for optimal performance on varied terrains. The Mechanical Disc Brake system with 160mm rotors offers reliable stopping power, ensuring you can confidently navigate any situation.
Quality Construction:
Constructed with an oversize hi-ten steel chopper frame and a Tracer Triple Tree Dual Aluminum Crown Disc Brake fork, these cruisers strike a perfect balance between durability and agility. The alloy components, such as the stem and brake levers, add strength without sacrificing weight.
Versatile Riding Options:
Choose between the Single Speed option for a simplified and carefree cruising experience or the 7 Speed option for versatile riding capabilities, allowing you to tackle inclines and flats with ease.
Stylish Fat Tires:
Equipped with 26”x3.0 fat tires, these cruisers offer enhanced stability and control, allowing you to conquer a variety of terrains while maintaining a smooth and comfortable ride.
Elevate your biking experience with the Tracer 29” GT/GT7 Speed Bicycles Avalon Beach Cruiser Bikes. Whether you're strolling along the beach, commuting through the city, or simply enjoying a leisurely ride, these cruisers are designed to provide the perfect blend of style, comfort, and performance. Get ready to turn your cycling adventures into unforgettable memories with the Tracer Avalon Beach Cruiser Bikes. Choose your size, choose your color, and hit the road in style!
